trainer/30570.htm.text: Prefect Karukia: I am a proud daughter of the Wolf Atuba tribe . It must have been Pa'agrio's will that you came when you did! What do you seek?

links.text: Ask about the Scepter of Wolves.

trainer/30570-1.htm.text: Prefect Karukia: We Atuka Orcs are the Scepter of the Wolf! The Wolf is our brother and our guardian, and has been the symbol of our tribe for a long time. The other Orc tribes also have unique symbols. The Hestui tribe bear the symbol of the Bear, the Neruga tribe bear the symbol of the Bat, the U…

trainer/30570-noteach.htm.text: Prefect Karukia: You fool! You don't know who I am! I will no longer talk to you.

Q00414_PathOfTheOrcRaider/30570-01.htm.text: Prefect Karukia: Orc Raiders are of the most elite rank among fighters of our race! Their mere appearance on the battlefield makes the enemy troops shiver in fear! To earn the qualifications to become an Orc Raider, you must prove that you have courage that has no regard for death, and absolute loy…

links.text: Say you want to be an Orc Raider

Q00414_PathOfTheOrcRaider/30570-06.html.text: Prefect Karukia: Why have you come back already? Didn't I tell you to bring back ten kuruka ratman teeth ? Is this all the courage you can muster?

Q00414_PathOfTheOrcRaider/30570-07.html.text: Prefect Karukia: You accomplished the mission well, but don't get too sure of yourself! As an Orc Raider, that should've been nothing to you! Now you must prove your loyalty. Two Judges await you. Which do you want to go to?

Q00414_PathOfTheOrcRaider/30570-02.htm.text: Prefect Karukia: Of course, I know your goal is to be a dignified and noble member of our race. But courage unsupported by ability is foolishness! That is a path that leads only to a meaningless death. Train patiently, youngster, and your chance will come. See me again when you reach level 18!

Q00414_PathOfTheOrcRaider/30570-02a.htm.text: Prefect Karukia: You fool! You have already been selected as a courageous Orc Raider! Don't waste my time with useless questions. Go out to the battlefield and strike down the enemy!

Q00414_PathOfTheOrcRaider/30570-03.htm.text: Prefect Karukia: Only the most courageous Orc Fighters are chosen to be Orc Raiders. You don't have the qualifications to become a Marauder!

Q00414_PathOfTheOrcRaider/30570-04.htm.text: Prefect Karukia: Oh! The Mark of the Raider! Another strong Warrior is born to fight for the Kingdom! Ha! You must go at once to the Kingdom of Humans and show this mark to the High Prefect there! He'll transfer you to the Raider class. You should visit either High Prefect Osborn in Gludin Village …

Q00414_PathOfTheOrcRaider/30570-05.htm.text: Prefect Karukia: Then, I will give you a test! Orc Raiders are completed when they show courage that is unafraid of death and loyalty that is absolute. First, you must prove your loyalty. Destroy the goblins that spoil the earth and the Kuruka Ratman Leaders that control that filthy race! Take this…

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
